command:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# The managed Ubuntu 16.04 image advertises ESM repositories, but this
# disposable task has no ESM credentials. The public Xenial repositories carry
# the MariaDB packages and their required dependencies.
sudo -n sed -i \
  '/^[[:space:]]*deb .*esm\.ubuntu\.com\/infra\/ubuntu xenial-infra-/s/^/# disabled for InfraSet task: /' \
  /etc/apt/sources.list
sudo -n apt-get update
sudo -n apt-get install -y mariadb-server mariadb-client
sudo -n systemctl enable --now mysql
sudo -n systemctl is-active mysql
